entities.summary: Eric von Schmidt was an American folk musician and painter. He was associated with the folk boom of the late 1950s and early 1960s and was a key part of the Cambridge folk music scene. As a singer and guitarist, he was considered to be the leading specialist in country blues in Cambridge at the time, the counterpart of Greenwich Village's Dave Van Ronk. Von Schmidt co-authored with Jim Rooney Baby, Let Me Follow You Down: The Illustrated Story of the Cambridge Folk Years. Eric Von Schmidt was a composers & musicians from Westport (1931-05-28, Westport–2007-02-02). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Eric von Schmidt was a key figure in the Cambridge folk music scene of the late 1950s and early 1960s, influencing the development of country blues and contributing to the folk boom. His work with Jim Rooney helped preserve the legacy of American folk music.
